headerEntries: The aarakocra casts {@spell 羽落术|XPHB} in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The aarakocra makes two Wind Staff attacks, and it can use Spellcasting to cast {@spell 造风术|XPHB}.

action.name: 风之杖
entries: {@atkr 米，半径} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Lightning damage.

treasure: 梅尔奇斯雇佣了一艘船，将队伍带到阿梅迪奥丛林。使用地图确定海上旅行的时间，取决于冒险者开始旅行的地点，并假设船每天覆盖大约1½个六边形区域。在旅程接近结束时，当船只穿越杰克莱亚湾时，它遭到了一群敌对的萨胡金人的袭击，包括两名萨胡金祭司、六名萨胡金战士和一名水元素。（假设船员避开了这些可怕的怪物，让角色和梅尔奇斯处理这个威胁。）第一阶段在梅尔奇斯和角色划小船上岸时结束。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 邪教徒可以进行两次触须鞭击攻击。它可以用心灵腐化替代任何一次攻击。

action.name: 触须鞭击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of two tentacles, and it has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: 心智腐化
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, one creature the cultist can see within 90 feet. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition until the start of the cultist's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

treasure: 梅尔奇斯雇佣了一艘船，将队伍带到阿梅迪奥丛林。使用地图确定海上旅行的时间，取决于冒险者开始旅行的地点，并假设船每天覆盖大约1½个六边形区域。在旅程接近结束时，当船只穿越杰克莱亚湾时，它遭到了一群敌对的萨胡金人的袭击，包括两名萨胡金祭司、六名萨胡金战士和一名水元素。（假设船员避开了这些可怕的怪物，让角色和梅尔奇斯处理这个威胁。）第一阶段在梅尔奇斯和角色划小船上岸时结束。

trait.name: 水陆两栖
entries: 底栖魔鱼可以在空气和水中呼吸。

trait.name: 奥法恢复
entries: If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in {@dice 5d10} days, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the DM.

trait.name: 传奇抗性（3次/日，或在巢穴中为4次/日）
entries: 如果失败豁免检定，灵吸怪可以选择改为成功。

trait.name: 黏液云雾
entries: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth's turn. {@actSaveFail} The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target's skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can't regain {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} unless it is underwater.

While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed.

trait.name: 探查感应
entries: 如果一个阿波罗斯（一种虚构的怪物）能看到的生物通过心灵感应与阿波罗斯交流，阿波罗斯就会了解这个生物最深的欲望。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 夺心魔可以进行两次触手攻击，如果可用的化，还会使用吞噬记忆或支配心智。

action.name: 触须
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 15 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of four tentacles.

action.name: 吞噬记忆
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 16}, one creature within 30 feet that is {@condition 魅惑|XPHB} or {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} by the aboleth. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The aboleth gains the target's memories if the target is a Humanoid and is reduced to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} by this action.

action.name: 支配心智（2次/日）
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 魅惑|XPHB} condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. While {@condition 魅惑|XPHB}, the target acts as an ally to the aboleth and is under its control while within 60 feet of it. In addition, the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.
目标在受到伤害时以及每24小时保持与巨脑兽至少1英里距离时重复进行豁免检定, 成功后效果结束。

legendary.name: 鞭击
entries: 夺心魔进行一次触须攻击。

legendary.name: 心灵汲取
entries: If the aboleth has at least one creature {@condition 魅惑|XPHB} or {@condition 擒抱|XPHB}, it uses Consume Memories and regains 5 ({@dice 1d10}) {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}.

trait.name: 畏火
entries: If the yeti takes Fire damage, it has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 雪人可以使用其冰冷凝视并进行两次攻击，任意组合使用利爪或冰投掷。

action.name: 爪击

action.name: 冰霜投掷
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 11}, range 60/240 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d4 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Cold damage.

action.name: 寒颤凝视
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, one creature the yeti can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} condition until the start of the yeti's next turn unless the target has {@variantrule 免疫|XPHB} to Cold damage. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this yeti's Chilling Gaze for 1 hour.

entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Cold damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

The tome has AC 17; HP 35; and {@variantrule 免疫|XPHB} to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage. The tome regains all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} or when the arcanaloth dies. When the target escapes, it appears in the space it left or, if that space is occupied, the nearest unoccupied space.

entries: At the end of each of the azer's turns, each creature of the azer's choice in a 5-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the azer takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Fire damage unless the azer has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: 照明
entries: The azer sheds {@variantrule 明亮光照|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule 微光光照|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 火矮人发动两次火焰爆发攻击。

action.name: 火焰爆发
entries: {@atkr 米，半径} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Fire damage.

treasure: 梅尔奇斯雇佣了一艘船，将队伍带到阿梅迪奥丛林。使用地图确定海上旅行的时间，取决于冒险者开始旅行的地点，并假设船每天覆盖大约1½个六边形区域。在旅程接近结束时，当船只穿越杰克莱亚湾时，它遭到了一群敌对的萨胡金人的袭击，包括两名萨胡金祭司、六名萨胡金战士和一名水元素。（假设船员避开了这些可怕的怪物，让角色和梅尔奇斯处理这个威胁。）第一阶段在梅尔奇斯和角色划小船上岸时结束。

trait.name: 集群战术
entries: The baboon has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the baboon's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 1}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 ({@damage 1d4 - 1}) Piercing damage.

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Piercing damage.

monster.name: 巴洛炎魔
languages: 深渊语；心灵感应 120 尺

trait.name: 临终苦难
entries: The balor explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the balor. {@actSaveFail} 31 ({@damage 9d6}) Fire damage plus 31 ({@damage 9d6}) Force damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If the balor dies outside the Abyss, it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere in the Abyss.

trait.name: 火焰灵光
entries: At the end of each of the balor's turns, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the balor takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Fire damage.

trait.name: 传奇抗性 (3/日)
entries: 如果巴洛尔在豁免检定中失败，它可以选择改为成功。

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The balor has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 巴洛炎魔进行一次火焰长鞭攻击和一次闪电剑攻击。

action.name: 火焰鞭
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 30 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d6 + 8}) Force damage plus 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Fire damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the balor pulls the target up to 25 feet straight toward itself, and the target has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 雷电刃
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d8 + 8}) Force damage plus 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Lightning damage, and the target can't take Reactions until the start of the balor's next turn.

bonus.name: 传送术
entries: 巴洛魔可以将自己或一个自愿的恶魔传送到它可以看见的未占用空间，距离它不超过60英尺且位于其10英尺范围内。

action.name: 弯刀
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Slashing damage.

action.name: 轻弩
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 3}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Piercing damage.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 强盗会进行两次攻击，可以任意组合使用弯刀和手枪。

action.name: 弯刀
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: 手枪
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 30/90 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Piercing damage.

reaction.name: 格挡
entries: {@actTrigger} The bandit is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} The bandit adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

trait.name: 反射闪避
entries: If the bandit is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the bandit instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 强盗使用弯刀或手枪进行三次攻击，组合方式不限。

action.name: 弯刀
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: 手枪
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 30/90 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: 致命瞄准
entries: The bandit gives itself {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes during the current turn. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Poison damage.

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The bandit casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 强盗进行三次匕首攻击。

action.name: 匕首
entries: {@atkr 米，半径} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Blinding Flash {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule 球体 [区域效果]|XPHB|球状} centered on a point the bandit can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} condition until the start of the bandit's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: 侦测生命
entries: 女妖能够以魔法感知到1英里内非构装体或不死生物的生物的方向。

trait.name: 虚体移动
entries: The banshee can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule 困难地形|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 幽魂女妖进行两次腐化之触攻击并使用恐怖尖啸。

action.name: 腐化之触
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: 恐怖
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, one creature the banshee can see within 60 feet that can see the banshee. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition until the start of the banshee's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this banshee's Horrify for 24 hours.

action.name: 死亡哀嚎（1次/日）
entries: The banshee releases a mournful wail if it isn't in sunlight. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature within 30 feet that can hear the wail and isn't a Construct or an Undead. {@actSaveFail} If the target has 25 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} or fewer, it drops to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}. Otherwise, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage.

monster.name: 猬魔
senses: 120 尺黑暗视觉（不受魔法黑暗影响）
languages: 炼狱语；心灵感应 120 尺

trait.name: 猬皮
entries: At the start of each of its turns, the devil deals 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Piercing damage to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.

trait.name: 恶魔之恢复
entries: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere in the Nine Hells.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The devil has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 魔鬼进行一次爪击和一次尾击，或者进行两次火焰投掷攻击。

action.name: 爪击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}) from both claws.

action.name: 尾击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: 投掷烈焰
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 150 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 5d6}) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

monster.name: 巴古拉魔
languages: 深渊语；心灵感应 120 尺

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The barlgura casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: 恶魔恢复
entries: If the barlgura dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere in the Abyss.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 巴洛格进行一次痛苦撕咬攻击和两次鞭笞攻击。

action.name: 折磨之咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Psychic damage.

action.name: 鞭笞
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: 跳跃
entries: 巴洛格拉通过消耗10英尺的移动力可以跳跃最多40英尺。

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Petrifying Gaze {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. If the basilisk sees its reflection within the {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}, the basilisk must make this save. {@actSaveFail 1} The target has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still {@condition 束缚|XPHB}, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveFail 2} The target has the {@condition 石化|XPHB} condition instead of the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Piercing damage.

monster.name: 须魔
senses: 120 尺黑暗视觉（不受魔法黑暗影响）
languages: 炼狱语；心灵感应 120 尺

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The devil has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 魔鬼发动一次胡须攻击和一次地狱大砍刀攻击。

action.name: 须刺
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition until the start of the devil's next turn. Until this poison ends, the target can't regain {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}.

action.name: 炼狱长戟
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Slashing damage. If the target is a creature and doesn't already have an infernal wound, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target receives an infernal wound. While wounded, the target loses 5 ({@dice 1d10}) {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill 医药|XPHB}) check.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 贝希摩斯进行一次噬咬攻击并使用束缚。

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Lightning damage.

action.name: 绞缠
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18}, one Large or smaller creature the behir can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 5d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}), and it has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Lightning Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule 线 [区域效果]|XPHB|线状}. {@actSaveFail} 66 ({@damage 12d10}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: 吞咽
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} by the behir (the behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The behir swallows the target, which is no longer {@condition 擒抱|XPHB}. While swallowed, a creature has the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} and {@condition 束缚|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule 掩护|XPHB|全身掩护} against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns.

If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the behir and has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition 束缚|XPHB} and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition 倒地|XPHB}.

trait.name: 传奇抗性（3次/日，或在巢穴中为4次/日）
entries: 如果眼魔在一次豁免检定中失败，它可以选择改为成功。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 眼魔使用了三次眼射线。

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: 眼波射线
entries: The beholder randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet of itself (roll {@dice 1d10}; reroll if the beholder has already used that ray during this turn):

items.name: 1: 魅惑射线
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 魅惑|XPHB} condition for 1 hour or until it takes damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: 2: 麻痹射线
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

items.name: 3: 恐惧射线
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: 4: 减速射线
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target's {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} is halved; the target can't take Reactions; and it can take either an action or a {@variantrule 附赠动作|XPHB} on its turn, not both. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: 5：削弱射线
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. While {@condition 中毒|XPHB}, the target can't regain {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: 6: 心灵遥控射线
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 16} (the target succeeds automatically if it is Gargantuan). {@actSaveFail} The beholder moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction. The target has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition until the start of the beholder's next turn or until the beholder has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition. The beholder can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a tool or opening a door or container.

items.name: 7：睡眠射线
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16} (the target succeeds automatically if it is a Construct or an Undead). {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 昏迷|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The condition ends if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

items.name: 8: 石化射线
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail 1} The target has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still {@condition 束缚|XPHB}, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveFail 2} The target has the {@condition 石化|XPHB} condition instead of the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition.

items.name: 9：解离射线
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Force damage. If the target is a nonmagical object or a creation of magical force, a 10-foot {@variantrule 立方 [效应区域]|XPHB|立方} of it disintegrates into dust. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, it disintegrates into dust.

items.name: 10：死亡射线
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}.

bonus.name: 反魔法锥域
entries: The beholder's central eye emits an antimagic wave in a 150-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. Until the start of the beholder's next turn, that area acts as an {@spell 反魔法场|XPHB} spell, and that area works against the beholder's own Eye Rays.

legendary.name: 咔哧
entries: 眼魔进行两次啃咬攻击。

legendary.name: 怒视

entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 5d10}) Force damage. trait.name: 浴血狂怒
entries: While {@variantrule 浴血|XPHB}, the berserker has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws.

Each new pudding is one size smaller than the original pudding and acts on its {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB}. The original pudding's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} are divided evenly between the new puddings (round down).

An engulfed creature that is reduced to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} dissolves into ash, which is ejected into the Astral Sea. {@actSaveSuccess} The target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

languages: 炼狱语；心灵感应 120 尺

trait.name: 恶魔之恢复
entries: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere in the Nine Hells.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The devil has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击

entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of two chains, and it has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: 召唤炼狱锁链

If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to 30 feet straight toward itself. {@actSaveSuccess} The chain disappears.

reaction.name: 令人不安的凝视

On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to be berserk until it is destroyed or it is no longer {@variantrule 浴血|XPHB}.

headerEntries: The dao casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: 遁地
entries: 土巨灵可以掘穴穿过非魔法且未经加工的泥土及岩石中移动。以此使用掘穴速度时，土巨灵不会破坏其穿过的任何材质。

trait.name: 元素恢复
entries: If the dao dies outside the Elemental Plane of Earth, its body dissolves into dirt, and it gains a new body in {@dice 1d4} days, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere on the Plane of Earth.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The dao has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: 许愿
entries: The dao has a 30 percent chance of knowing the {@spell 祈愿术|XPHB} spell. If the dao knows it, the dao can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the dao can understand. If the dao casts the spell for the creature, the dao suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the dao has cast it three times, the dao can't do so again for 365 days.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 地灵魔像发动三次地之槌攻击或两次地之爆发攻击。

action.name: 地石重锤
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 大地爆裂
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 120 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. {@hom}Earth explodes from the target's space, creating the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from and including the target. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Thunder damage.

action.name: 碾压
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on the attack roll, it covers the target, which has the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way.

While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on its attack rolls. Its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB}, and it moves with the target.

A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill 运动|XPHB}) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.

action.name: 黑暗灵光 (1/日)
entries: Magical {@variantrule 黑暗术|XPHB} fills a 15-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the darkmantle. This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains {@status 专注|XPHB} on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can't penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.

legendary.name: 堕落之语

legendary.name: 突刺

entries: 史拉蟾发动两次混沌之刃攻击。

action.name: 混沌之刃

Until the start of the slaad's next turn, the target has a condition determined by rolling {@dice 1d4}: on a 1, {@condition 魅惑|XPHB}; on a 2, {@condition 恐慌|XPHB}; on a 3, {@condition 中毒|XPHB}; or on a 4, {@condition 失能|XPHB}.

bonus.name: 变形
entries: 史拉蟾变形成为一个小型或中型类人生物，或者恢复其真实形态。除了体型外，其游戏统计数据在每种形态下都相同。它所穿戴或携带的任何装备都不会被转换。

trait.name: 传奇抗性（3次/日，或在巢穴中为4次/日）
entries: 如果死亡暴君在豁免检定中失败，它可以选择改为成功。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 死灵暴君使用死光射线三次。

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 feet. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: 眼波射线
entries: The death tyrant randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet of itself (roll {@dice 1d10}; reroll if the death tyrant has already used that ray during this turn):

items.name: 1: 魅惑射线
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 魅惑|XPHB} condition for 1 hour or until it takes damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: 2: 麻痹射线
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

items.name: 3: 恐惧射线
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: 4: 减速射线
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Necrotic damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target can't take Reactions; its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} is halved; and it can take either an action or a {@variantrule 附赠动作|XPHB} on its turn, not both. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: 5：削弱射线
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. While {@condition 中毒|XPHB}, the target can't regain {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

items.name: 6: 心灵遥控射线
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 17} (the target succeeds automatically if it is Gargantuan). {@actSaveFail} The death tyrant moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction. The target has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition until the start of the death tyrant's next turn or until the death tyrant has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition. The death tyrant can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a tool or opening a door or container.

items.name: 7：睡眠射线
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17} (the target succeeds automatically if it is a Construct or an Undead). {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 昏迷|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The condition ends if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

items.name: 8: 石化射线
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail 1} The target has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still {@condition 束缚|XPHB}, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveFail 2} The target has the {@condition 石化|XPHB} condition instead of the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition.

items.name: 9：解离射线
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Force damage. If the target is a nonmagical object or a creation of magical force, a 10-foot {@variantrule 立方 [效应区域]|XPHB|立方} of it disintegrates into dust. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, it disintegrates into dust.

items.name: 10：死亡射线
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}.

bonus.name: 负能量锥域

Creatures in that area can't regain {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} until the start of the death tyrant's next turn. An intact Humanoid corpse there instantly rises as a {@creature 僵尸|XMM} under the death tyrant's control and takes its turn immediately after the death tyrant on the same initiative count.

entries: {@atkr 米，半径} {@hit 11}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}24 ({@damage 7d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Howl {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the demilich. {@actSaveFail} 70 ({@damage 20d6}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition until the start of the demilich's next turn.

legendary.name: 能量吸取 (消耗 2动作)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, one creature the demilich can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} maximum decreases by 14 ({@dice 4d6}). {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The demilich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: 墓尘之飞
entries: The demilich flies up to its {@variantrule 飞行速度|XPHB}, shedding grave dust. Each creature within 5 feet of the demilich as it moves is targeted once by the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 19}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} condition until the end of the demilich's next turn. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The demilich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: 坏死
entries: 半巫妖进行一次死灵爆裂攻击。

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The deva casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):
will: {@spell 形体变化|XPHB} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no {@variantrule 临时生命值|XPHB} gained from the spell, and no Concentration or {@variantrule 临时生命值|XPHB} required to maintain the spell)

spellcasting.name: 神助（2次/日）
headerEntries: The deva casts {@spell 疗伤术|XPHB}, {@spell 次级复原术|XPHB}, or {@spell 移除诅咒|XPHB}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: 崇高复原
entries: If the deva dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere in Mount Celestia.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The deva has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 天族生物进行两次神圣钉头锤攻击。

action.name: 神圣钉头锤
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Radiant damage.

trait.name: 集群战术
entries: The wolf has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The worg has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 座狼进行三次撕咬攻击。

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition until the start of the worg's next turn. While {@condition 中毒|XPHB}, the target can't regain {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}.

action.name: Dreadful Howl {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each creature within 30 feet that isn't a worg. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition until the start of the worg's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: 跃迁步
entries: 座狼可以传送到它可见的30英尺内一个未被占据的空间，并且可以选择一个距离它5英尺内的自愿生物一同传送。

monster.name: 移位兽
languages: 理解希尔瓦语但无法说话

trait.name: 豁免闪避
entries: If the displacer beast is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: 移位
entries: Attack rolls against the displacer beast have {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB}, since it projects an illusion that makes it appear to be near its actual location. This trait is suppressed while the displacer beast has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 移位兽进行一次撕裂攻击和一次触须攻击。

action.name: 撕裂
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 feet. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Slashing damage. If target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 触须
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 feet. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The djinni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

2e: {@spell 造粮术|XPHB} (can create wine instead of water)

trait.name: 元素恢复
entries: If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in {@dice 1d4} days, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere on the Plane of Air.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The djinni has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: 许愿
entries: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the {@spell 祈愿术|XPHB} spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can't do so again for 365 days.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 巨灵进行三次攻击，任意组合使用风暴之刃或风暴之箭。

action.name: 风暴之刃
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 feet. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Lightning damage.

action.name: 风暴之箭
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 120 feet. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 生成旋风
entries: The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high {@variantrule 柱状 [效应区域]|XPHB|柱状} centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni's {@status 专注|XPHB} on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns.

Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature's space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 17} (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). {@actSaveFail} While in the whirlwind, the target has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} target takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster.name: 变形怪
languages: 通用语加上其他三种语言

spellcasting.name: 读心
headerEntries: The doppelganger casts {@spell 侦测思想|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}).

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 分身怪进行两次徒手攻击，并尽可能使用不安面容。

action.name: 猛击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} (with {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} during the first round of each combat), reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Unsettling Visage {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the doppelganger that can see the doppelganger. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonus.name: 变形
entries: 拟形怪可以变形为一个中型或小型类人生物，或者恢复其真实形态。除了体型之外，它的游戏统计数据在每种形态下都相同。它所穿戴或携带的任何装备都不会被转变。

treasure: 梅尔奇斯雇佣了一艘船，将队伍带到阿梅迪奥丛林。使用地图确定海上旅行的时间，取决于冒险者开始旅行的地点，并假设船每天覆盖大约1½个六边形区域。在旅程接近结束时，当船只穿越杰克莱亚湾时，它遭到了一群敌对的萨胡金人的袭击，包括两名萨胡金祭司、六名萨胡金战士和一名水元素。（假设船员避开了这些可怕的怪物，让角色和梅尔奇斯处理这个威胁。）第一阶段在梅尔奇斯和角色划小船上岸时结束。

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The dracolich casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}, {@hit 11} to hit with spell attacks):

trait.name: 传奇抗性（3次/日，或在巢穴中为4次/日）
entries: 龙巫妖豁免失败时，可以将其改为豁免成功。

trait.name: 生命抑制
entries: Creatures within 60 feet of the dracolich can't regain {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The dracolich has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: 灵魂宝石
entries: The dracolich has a magical gem. If the dracolich is destroyed while the gem is on the same plane of existence as it, the dracolich gains a new body in {@dice 1d20} days, regaining all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} and appearing within 5 feet of the gem.

The gem is a Tiny object that has AC 20; HP 50; and {@variantrule 免疫|XPHB} to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage. The gem regains all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}. If the gem is destroyed, the dracolich can create a new one by completing an 8-hour ritual using a gem worth 1,000+ GP and by expending 5,000 GP, which the ritual consumes.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The dracolich makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell 致病射线|XPHB} (level 2 version).

action.name: 撕裂
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Necrotic Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 20}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. {@actSaveFail} 52 ({@damage 8d12}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

legendary.name: 猛扑
entries: The dracolich moves up to half its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB}, and it makes one Rend attack.

legendary.name: 恶毒射线
entries: The dracolich uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell 致病射线|XPHB} (level 2 version). The dracolich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: 恐怖的存在
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the dracolich. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The dracolich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

action.name: 蹄击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: 水陆两栖
entries: 龙可以在空气和水中呼吸。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 龙进行三次啮咬攻击。它可以将其中的一次攻击替换为尾击。

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 15 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage. Being underwater doesn't grant {@variantrule 抗性|XPHB} to this Fire damage.

action.name: 尾击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 15 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Steam Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. {@actSaveFail} 56 ({@damage 16d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Being underwater doesn't grant {@variantrule 抗性|XPHB} to this Fire damage.

monster.name: 怯魔
languages: 深渊语；心灵感应 60 尺（仅对理解深渊语的生物有效）

action.name: 撕裂
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Slashing damage.

action.name: 污臭之云（1/日）
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 11}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the dretch. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. While {@condition 中毒|XPHB}, the creature can take either an action or a {@variantrule 附赠动作|XPHB} on its turn, not both, and it can't take Reactions.

spellcasting.name: Magic of the Spider Queen {@recharge 5}
headerEntries: The drider casts {@spell 黑暗术|XPHB}, {@spell 妖火|XPHB}, or {@spell 蛛网术|XPHB}, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}).

trait.name: 蛛行术
entries: 蛛化精灵可以攀爬复杂的表面，包括天花板，而无需进行能力检定。

trait.name: 日照敏感
entries: While in sunlight, the drider has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls.

trait.name: 蛛网行者
entries: 蛛化精灵不受蛛网造成的移动限制影响，并且蛛化精灵知道与同一蛛网接触的任何其他生物的位置。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 蛛化精灵进行三次攻击，可任意组合使用前肢或毒爆攻击。

action.name: 前肢
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: 毒爆术
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 120 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Poison damage.

monster.name: 德鲁伊

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 德鲁伊使用藤蔓法杖或翠绿幽魂进行两次攻击，可任意组合。

action.name: 藤蔓法杖
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Poison damage.

action.name: 翠绿幽魂
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 90 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage.

treasure: 梅尔奇斯雇佣了一艘船，将队伍带到阿梅迪奥丛林。使用地图确定海上旅行的时间，取决于冒险者开始旅行的地点，并假设船每天覆盖大约1½个六边形区域。在旅程接近结束时，当船只穿越杰克莱亚湾时，它遭到了一群敌对的萨胡金人的袭击，包括两名萨胡金祭司、六名萨胡金战士和一名水元素。（假设船员避开了这些可怕的怪物，让角色和梅尔奇斯处理这个威胁。）第一阶段在梅尔奇斯和角色划小船上岸时结束。

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):
will: {@spell 魅惑怪物|XPHB} (lasts 24 hours; ends early if the dryad casts the spell again)

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The dryad has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: 动植物交谈
entries: 树精可以与任何野兽和植物进行交流，如同它们掌握同一种语言一样。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The dryad makes one Vine Lash or Thorn Burst attack, and it can use Spellcasting to cast {@spell 魅惑怪物|XPHB}.

action.name: 藤鞭
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: 荆棘爆发
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 60 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: 树跃术
entries: 如果在距离一棵大型或更大树木5英尺范围内，树精可以传送到距离前一棵树60英尺范围内另一棵大型或更大树木5英尺内的一个未被占据的空间。

spellcasting.name: 睡眠术（1/日）
headerEntries: The mephit casts the {@spell 睡眠术|XPHB} spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 10}).

trait.name: 临终苦难
entries: The mephit explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the mephit. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: 爪击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Blinding Breath {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} condition until the end of the mephit's next turn.

action.name: 禽爪
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 feet. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Slashing damage.

trait.name: 遁地
entries: 元素生物可以掘穴穿过非魔法且未经加工的泥土及岩石中移动。以此使用掘穴速度时，土元素不会破坏其穿过的任何材质。

trait.name: 攻城怪物
entries: 元素生物对物件和建筑物造成双倍伤害。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 该元素生物可以进行两次攻击，使用猛击或投掷岩石的任意组合。

action.name: 猛击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 岩石发射
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 8}, range 60 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The efreeti casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: 元素恢复
entries: If the efreeti dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body dissolves into ash, and it gains a new body in {@dice 1d4} days, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere on the Plane of Fire.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The efreeti has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: 许愿
entries: The efreeti has a 30 percent chance of knowing the {@spell 祈愿术|XPHB} spell. If the efreeti knows it, the efreeti can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the efreeti can understand. If the efreeti casts the spell for the creature, the efreeti suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the efreeti has cast it three times, the efreeti can't do so again for 365 days.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 火巨灵进行三次攻击，可以使用炽热之刃或投掷火焰任意组合。

action.name: 炽热之刃
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Fire damage.

action.name: 投掷烈焰
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 8}, range 120 ft. {@h}24 ({@damage 7d6}) Fire damage.

spellcasting.name: 操控天气
headerEntries: The cataclysm casts the {@spell 操控天气|XPHB} spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability.

trait.name: 遁地
entries: 这灾变能够钻穿非魔法性质、未经加工的泥土和岩石。在这样做时，灾变不会扰乱它所穿过的物质。

trait.name: 传奇抗性（每日4次）
entries: 如果天启骰豁免失败，它可以选择改为成功。

trait.name: 攻城怪物
entries: 大灾变对物体和建筑物造成双倍伤害。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 灾变进行两次元素爆裂攻击。

action.name: 元素爆发
entries: {@atkr 米，半径} {@hit 15}, reach 30 ft. or range 150 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 5d6 + 8}) damage of a type chosen by the cataclysm: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.

action.name: Cataclysmic Event {@recharge 4}
entries: The cataclysm creates one of the following effects at random (roll {@dice 1d4}):

items.name: 1: 粘附烈焰
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 60-foot-radius {@variantrule 球体 [区域效果]|XPHB|球状} centered on a point the cataclysm can see within 150 feet. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 13d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The target starts burning.

items.name: 2: 冰封之浪
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 90-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 5d8}) Bludgeoning damage plus 22 ({@damage 5d8}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The target's {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

items.name: 3：暴风怒涛
entries: A storm cloud fills a 60-foot-radius {@variantrule 球体 [区域效果]|XPHB|球状} centered on a point the cataclysm can see within 150 feet. The cloud lasts for 1 minute or until the cataclysm uses Cataclysmic Event again. Creatures entirely in the cloud have the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} and {@condition 耳聋|XPHB} conditions and can't cast spells with a Verbal component. {@actSave dex} {@dc 23}, each creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Lightning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Thunder damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

items.name: 第四式：吞地
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 90-foot {@variantrule 立方 [效应区域]|XPHB|立方} originating from a point on the ground within 150 feet. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Acid damage, and the target has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition and is buried under rubble. A buried target has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition, has {@variantrule 掩护|XPHB|全身掩护}, and is suffocating. As an action, a buried creature or another creature within 5 feet of it can make a {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill 运动|XPHB}) check. On a successful check, the creature is no longer buried. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

legendary.name: 爆发
entries: 灾变发动一次元素爆裂攻击。

legendary.name: 轰鸣移动
entries: The cataclysm moves up to its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB}, {@variantrule 飞行速度|XPHB}, or {@variantrule 游泳速度|XPHB} without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature within 5 feet of the cataclysm as it moves is targeted once by the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 23}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The cataclysm can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

monster.name: 元素邪教徒

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 邪教徒可以使用元素连枷或元素利爪进行最多三次攻击，两者可以任意组合使用。

action.name: 元素连枷
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 6d6 + 4}) damage of a type chosen by the cultist: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.

action.name: 元素之爪
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 120 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) damage of a type chosen by the cultist: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the cultist moves the target up to 10 feet straight toward or away from itself.

reaction.name: 元素吸收（1次/日）
entries: {@actTrigger} The cultist takes Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. {@actResponse} The cultist gives itself {@variantrule 抗性|XPHB} to that instance of damage and gains 10 {@variantrule 临时生命值|XPHB}.

treasure: 梅尔奇斯雇佣了一艘船，将队伍带到阿梅迪奥丛林。使用地图确定海上旅行的时间，取决于冒险者开始旅行的地点，并假设船每天覆盖大约1½个六边形区域。在旅程接近结束时，当船只穿越杰克莱亚湾时，它遭到了一群敌对的萨胡金人的袭击，包括两名萨胡金祭司、六名萨胡金战士和一名水元素。（假设船员避开了这些可怕的怪物，让角色和梅尔奇斯处理这个威胁。）第一阶段在梅尔奇斯和角色划小船上岸时结束。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 大象进行两次冲刺攻击。

action.name: 顶撞
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the elephant moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: 践踏
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, one creature within 5 feet that has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: 攻城槌
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the elk moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The empyrean casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 23}):

trait.name: 传奇抗性（每日4次）
entries: 至高天豁免失败时，可以将其改为豁免成功。

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The empyrean has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 这位天族使用神圣武器或神圣光线进行两次攻击，攻击方式可以任意组合。

action.name: 神圣武器
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 17}, reach 10 ft. {@h}31 ({@damage 6d6 + 10}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition 震慑|XPHB} condition until the start of the empyrean's next turn. The target can choose not to be {@condition 震慑|XPHB}, in which case it takes an extra 21 Force damage that bypasses {@variantrule 抗性|XPHB} or {@variantrule 免疫|XPHB}.

action.name: 神圣射线
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 15}, range 600 ft. {@h}35 ({@damage 6d8 + 8}) Necrotic or Radiant damage (empyrean's choice).

legendary.name: 鼓舞
entries: The empyrean gains 10 {@variantrule 临时生命值|XPHB}, and the empyrean and each ally within 30 feet of it gain {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 检定|XPHB|D20 检定} until the end of the empyrean's next turn. The empyrean can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: 荣耀冲击波
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the empyrean. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The empyrean can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: 猛击
entries: 位面使者进行一次神圣射线攻击。

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: 天族施放以下法术之一，无需材料成分，并使用感知作为施法属性：

spellcasting.name: 治疗字（1次/日）
headerEntries: The empyrean casts {@spell 治愈真言|XPHB}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: 虚体移动
entries: The empyrean can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule 困难地形|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The empyrean has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 异界打击
entries: {@atkr 米，半径} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Necrotic or Radiant damage (empyrean's choice).

monster.name: 欲魔
languages: 炼狱语；心灵感应 120 尺

trait.name: 恶魔之恢复
entries: If the erinyes dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere in the Nine Hells.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The erinyes has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: 魔法绳
entries: The erinyes has a magic rope. While bearing it, the erinyes can use the Entangling Rope action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and {@variantrule 免疫|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, if it is 5+ feet away from the erinyes for 1 hour or more, or if the erinyes dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the erinyes can fully restore it when finishing a {@variantrule 短休|XPHB|短} or {@variantrule 长休|XPHB}.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 复仇女神进行三次枯萎之剑攻击，并能使用缠绕之绳。

action.name: 枯萎之剑
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: 缠绕绳索（需要魔法绳索）
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 16}, one creature the erinyes can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition until the rope is destroyed, the erinyes uses a {@variantrule 附赠动作|XPHB} to release the target, or the erinyes uses Entangling Rope again.

reaction.name: 格挡
entries: {@actTrigger} The erinyes is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

trait.name: 蛛行术
entries: 蛛化精灵可以攀爬困难的表面，包括天花板，而无需进行能力检定。

trait.name: 蛛网行者
entries: 蛛化精灵无视由蛛网造成的移动限制，并且蛛化精灵知晓与同一张蛛网接触的任何其他生物的位置。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 蛛化精灵进行一次噬咬攻击和一次爪击攻击。

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.

action.name: 爪击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Web Strand {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; {@variantrule 易伤|XPHB} to Fire damage; {@variantrule 免疫|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

bonus.name: 拖拽
entries: The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is {@condition 束缚|XPHB} by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.

monster.name: 双头巨人

action.name: 多重攻击

action.name: 战斧

action.name: 钉头锤
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage, and the target has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While {@condition 失能|XPHB}, the target uses all its movement on each of its turns to move in a random direction.

entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn and uses all its movement on its turn to move in a random direction.

senses: 黑暗视觉 90 尺（不受魔法黑暗影响）

spellcasting.name: 炼狱叱喝
headerEntries: The cultist casts {@spell 炼狱叱喝|XPHB} in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 邪教徒进行三次契约战斧攻击。

action.name: 契约之斧
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Fire damage.

trait.name: 火焰灵光
entries: At the end of each of the elemental's turns, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the elemental takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} start {@hazard 焚烧|XPHB}.

trait.name: 火焰形态
entries: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Fire damage.

trait.name: 照明
entries: The elemental sheds {@variantrule 明亮光照|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule 微光光照|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet.

trait.name: 水体易感
entries: The elemental takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Cold damage for every 5 feet the elemental moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 该元素生物进行两次灼烧攻击。

action.name: 燃烧
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts burning.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 巨人可以进行两次攻击，使用火焰剑或投掷锤的任何组合。

action.name: 火焰剑
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: 投掷战锤
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 11}, range 60/240 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Fire damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the giant and has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

monster.name: 燃焰之颅
languages: 通用语加上另外两种语言

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The flameskull casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

trait.name: 照明
entries: The flameskull sheds {@variantrule 明亮光照|XPHB} in a 15-foot radius and {@variantrule 微光光照|XPHB} for an additional 15 feet.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The flameskull has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: 亡灵恢复
entries: If the flameskull is destroyed, it regains all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in 1 hour unless Holy Water is sprinkled on its remains or the {@spell 反制善恶|XPHB} spell is cast on them.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 焰颅发动两次火焰射线攻击。

action.name: 火焰射线
entries: {@atkr 米，半径} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Fire damage.

monster.name: 火焰骷髅
languages: 理解通用语和另一门语言但无法说话

trait.name: 临终苦难
entries: The skeleton explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the skeleton. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: 照明
entries: The skeleton sheds {@variantrule 明亮光照|XPHB} in a 15-foot radius and {@variantrule 微光光照|XPHB} for an additional 15 feet.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 骷髅可以使用火焰权杖或投掷火焰进行两种攻击，任意组合。

action.name: 火焰权杖
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: 投掷烈焰
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 60 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) Fire damage.

monster.name: 肉身魔像
languages: 理解通用语和另一门语言但无法说话

trait.name: 厌火
entries: If the golem takes Fire damage, it has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: 失心狂怒
entries: Whenever the golem starts its turn {@variantrule 浴血|XPHB}, roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer {@variantrule 浴血|XPHB}.

The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill 游说|XPHB}) check; the golem must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still {@variantrule 浴血|XPHB}.

trait.name: 不变形态
entries: 魔像不能变形。

trait.name: 闪电吸收
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The golem has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 魔像发动两次猛击攻击。

action.name: 猛击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Lightning damage.

monster.name: 呋噜
languages: 理解地底通用语但无法说；心灵感应 60 英尺

trait.name: 增强感应
entries: 浮空水母能感知60英尺范围内任何心灵感应的内容。

trait.name: 倒地缺陷
entries: If the flumph receives the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition, roll a die. On an odd number, it has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of its turns, the flumph makes a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, ending the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition on a success.

trait.name: 读心屏障
entries: 浮空水母的思想无法通过任何方式读取，魔法也无法侦测其位置或远程观察它。

entries: The cube fills its entire space and is transparent. Other creatures can enter that space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf and has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on the saving throw.
Creatures inside the cube have {@variantrule 掩护|XPHB|全身掩护}, and the cube can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or Small creatures inside itself at a time.

As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the cube can pull a creature or an object out of the cube by succeeding on a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill 运动|XPHB}) check, and the puller takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage.

trait.name: 透明

action.name: 吞没

The cube can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures if it has room inside itself to contain them (see the Ooze {@variantrule 立方 [效应区域]|XPHB|立方} trait). {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}, each creature whose space the cube enters for the first time during this move. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage, and the target is engulfed. An engulfed target is suffocating, can't cast spells with a Verbal component, has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition, and takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed target moves with it. An engulfed target can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill 运动|XPHB}) check. On a successful check, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage, and the target moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cube. If there is no unoccupied space, the target fails the save instead.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} or the ghost leaves as a {@variantrule 附赠动作|XPHB}. When the possession ends, the ghost appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost's {@variantrule 附身|XPHB} for 24 hours. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this ghost's {@variantrule 附身|XPHB} for 24 hours.

entries: The toad swallows a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. While swallowed, the target isn't {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} but has the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} and {@condition 束缚|XPHB} conditions, and it has {@variantrule 掩护|XPHB|全身掩护} against attacks and other effects outside the toad. In addition, the target takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage at the end of each of the toad's turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time, and it can't use Bite while it has a swallowed target. If the toad dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition 束缚|XPHB} and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

The intellect devourer retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; its understanding of Deep Speech; its telepathy; and its Detect Intelligence trait. It otherwise adopts the target's game statistics. It knows everything the target knew, including spells and languages.

If the host body dies, the intellect devourer must leave it. The intellect devourer is also forced out if the target regains its devoured brain by means of a {@spell 祈愿术|XPHB} spell. By spending 5 feet of its movement, the intellect devourer can voluntarily leave the body, teleporting to the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. The body then dies unless its brain is restored before the end of the intellect devourer's next turn.

Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB}. The original jelly's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down).

trait.name: 压缩
entries: 章鱼可以通过仅1英寸宽的狭窄空间，无需耗费额外的移动力。

trait.name: 水下呼吸
entries: 章鱼只能在水下呼吸。

action.name: 触须
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: 墨云（每日1次）
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the octopus while underwater. {@actResponse} The octopus releases ink that fills a 5-foot {@variantrule 立方 [效应区域]|XPHB|立方} centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its {@variantrule 游泳速度|XPHB}. The {@variantrule 立方 [效应区域]|XPHB|立方} is {@variantrule 重度遮蔽|XPHB} for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.

action.name: 巨棒
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 标枪
entries: {@atkr 米，半径} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

monster.name: 食人魔僵尸
languages: 能理解通用语和巨人语，但不能说话

trait.name: 不死坚韧
entries: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, it makes a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 5} plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a {@variantrule 重击|XPHB}. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} instead.

action.name: 猛击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 战斧
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: 标枪
entries: {@atkr 米，半径} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

spellcasting.name: 隐形术
headerEntries: The oni casts {@spell 隐形术|XPHB} on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: 再生
entries: The oni regains 10 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值}.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 鬼婆可以进行两次爪击或梦魇射线攻击。它可以用施法替代其中一次攻击。

action.name: 爪击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: 梦魇射线
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 60 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition until the start of the oni's next turn.

action.name: 变形
entries: 鬼婆可以变形为一个小型或中型类人生物，或一个大型巨人，或者恢复其真实形态。除了体型外，各形态的游戏数据都相同。它所穿戴或携带的任何装备都不会变化。

monster.name: 食腐兽
languages: 欧特鲁；心灵感应 120 尺（无法让接收生物以心灵感应回应）

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 俄提乌戈进行一次啃咬攻击和两次触手攻击。

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition. Whenever the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} target finishes a {@variantrule 长休|XPHB}, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} maximum decreases by 5 ({@dice 1d10}) and doesn't return to normal until the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition ends on the target. {@actSaveSuccess} The {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition ends.

action.name: 触须
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 13}) from one of two tentacles.

action.name: 触须猛击
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, each creature {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} by the otyugh. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition 震慑|XPHB} condition until the start of the otyugh's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: 飞掠
entries: 当猫头鹰飞出敌人的射程时，它不会引发借机攻击。

action.name: 禽爪

action.name: 多重攻击

action.name: 撕裂
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: 迅捷逃逸

action.name: 蹄击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Radiant damage.

entries: {@actTrigger} The performer is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} The performer halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.

treasure: 梅尔奇斯雇佣了一艘船，将队伍带到阿梅迪奥丛林。使用地图确定海上旅行的时间，取决于冒险者开始旅行的地点，并假设船每天覆盖大约1½个六边形区域。在旅程接近结束时，当船只穿越杰克莱亚湾时，它遭到了一群敌对的萨胡金人的袭击，包括两名萨胡金祭司、六名萨胡金战士和一名水元素。（假设船员避开了这些可怕的怪物，让角色和梅尔奇斯处理这个威胁。）第一阶段在梅尔奇斯和角色划小船上岸时结束。

entries: 蜘蛛可以攀爬困难的表面，包括沿着天花板，而无需进行属性检定。

trait.name: 蛛网行者
entries: 蜘蛛无视由蛛网引起的移动限制，并且蜘蛛知道任何其他与同一蛛网接触的生物的位置。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 蜘蛛进行两次噬咬攻击。

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, the target becomes {@variantrule 稳重|XPHB}, and it has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. While {@condition 中毒|XPHB}, the target also has the {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 啃咬

entries: The piercer falls. {@actSave dex} {@dc 11}, one creature directly underneath the piercer. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Piercing damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The piercer reduces any damage it takes from the fall by 20.

entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} (with {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} if the target doesn't have all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}), reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Piercing damage.

entries: 海盗进行两次匕首攻击。它可以用一次迷人风度的效果来替换一次攻击。

action.name: 匕首
entries: {@atkr 米，半径} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: 迷人的风度
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 12}, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 魅惑|XPHB} condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.

action.name: 弯刀

items.name: 敬畏

items.name: 毒素

entries: {@actTrigger} The pirate is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} The pirate adds 4 to its AC against melee attack rolls (including the triggering attack) until the start of its next turn, possibly causing the attacks to miss.

headerEntries: The pit fiend casts {@spell 火球术|XPHB} (level 5 version) twice, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 21}). It can replace one {@spell 火球术|XPHB} with {@spell 怪物定身术|XPHB} (level 7 version) or {@spell 火墙术|XPHB}.

trait.name: 恶魔之恢复
entries: If the pit fiend dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere in the Nine Hells.

trait.name: 恐惧灵光
entries: The pit fiend emanates an aura in a 20-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} while it doesn't have the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition. {@actSave wis} {@dc 21}, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this pit fiend's aura for 24 hours.

trait.name: 传奇抗性（每日4次）

After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonus.name: 吞咽
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 19}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} by the worm (it can have up to three creatures swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed by the worm, and the {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} and {@condition 束缚|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule 掩护|XPHB|全身掩护} against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the worm and has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition. If the worm dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition 倒地|XPHB}.

trait.name: 邪魔恢复
entries: If the rakshasa dies outside the Nine Hells, its body turns to ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere in the Nine Hells.

entries: The slaad regains 10 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值}.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 史拉蟾进行三次注入利爪攻击。

action.name: 注入之爪
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a slaad, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target is cursed unawares, and a minuscule slaad egg is implanted in it. Removing the curse destroys the egg.

Over {@dice 2d4 × 10} days, the egg gestates. In the final 24 hours, the cursed target feels unwell; its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} is halved, and it has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 检定|XPHB|D20 检定}. At the end of this time, the egg turns into a Slaad Tadpole, which chews out of the host and kills it.

trait.name: 集群战术
entries: The shark has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the shark's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: 水下呼吸

action.name: 啃咬

entries: At the end of each of the remorhaz's turns, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the remorhaz takes 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Fire damage.

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}), and it has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

bonus.name: 吞咽
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 19}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} by the remorhaz (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed by the remorhaz, and the {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} and {@condition 束缚|XPHB} conditions, it has {@variantrule 掩护|XPHB|全身掩护} against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.

If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the remorhaz and has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition. If the remorhaz dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting {@condition 倒地|XPHB}.

Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: 亡灵恢复
entries: If the revenant dies, it revives 24 hours later in a different body unless {@spell 反制善恶|XPHB} is cast on its corpse. If it revives, it animates a Humanoid corpse elsewhere on the same plane of existence; it now looks different but uses the same stat block and returns with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}.

After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. If the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} target is cursed by the revenant (see Vow of Revenge), the target also has the {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} condition for the duration.

The Charmed target is a willing recipient of the vampire's Bite, the damage of which doesn't end the spell. When the spell ends, the target is unaware it was Charmed by the vampire.

headerEntries: The vampire casts {@spell 命令术|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}). The vampire can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries: 吸血鬼豁免失败时，可以将其改为豁免成功。

trait.name: 雾遁
entries: If the vampire drops to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} outside its resting place, the vampire uses Shape-Shift to become mist (no action required). If it can't use Shape-Shift, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in mist form, it can't return to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} condition until it regains any {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, and it regains 1 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} after spending 1 hour there.

trait.name: 蛛行术

items.name: 禁制术
entries: 吸血鬼无法在没有居住者邀请的情况下进入住所。

items.name: 流动的水

items.name: 阳光

action.name: 啃咬（蝙蝠或吸血鬼形态）
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the {@condition 擒抱|XPHB}, {@condition 失能|XPHB}, or {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} equal to that amount. A Humanoid reduced to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a {@creature 吸血鬼衍体|XMM} under the vampire's control.

bonus.name: 变形
entries: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it shape-shifts into a Tiny bat ({@variantrule 速度|XPHB} 5 ft., {@variantrule 飞行速度|XPHB} 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist ({@variantrule 速度|XPHB} 5 ft., {@variantrule 飞行速度|XPHB} 20 ft. [hover]), or it returns to its vampire form. Anything it is wearing transforms with it.
While in bat form, the vampire can't speak. Its game statistics, other than its size and {@variantrule 速度|XPHB}, are unchanged.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. It has {@variantrule 抗性|XPHB} to all damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

trait.name: 流水形态

action.name: 多重攻击

action.name: Whelm {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, each creature in the elemental's space. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 擒抱|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition, is suffocating unless it can breathe water, and takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the elemental's turns. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at a time with Whelm. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the elemental can pull a creature out of it by succeeding on a {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill 运动|XPHB}) check. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: 水体联结
